title: Tap the rain rhythm
story: Three B raindrops land: quick, quick, and long.
childCue: Copy B, B, B. Let the last B stay a little longer.
adultCue: Pitch order is scored; rhythm is modelled but not graded. Leave a small release so repeated notes can be heard separately.
tips: Use a new doo for each drop.
The long drop can still feel easy.
